title: Coordenador Administrativo
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Liderar a gestão administrativa, contratual e de inteligência de mercado na Diretoria Comercial, promovendo o alinhamento estratégico, a excelência operacional e o uso de dados para orientar decisões, garantir resultados sustentáveis e desenvolver pessoas e processos com foco em eficiência e crescimento.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar o planejamento estratégico da área, incluindo orçamento, cronogramas, metas e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Atuar como interlocutor estratégico entre a Diretoria, áreas de negócios e equipe, promovendo o alinhamento e engajamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Apoiar a construção e desdobramento da estratégia corporativa, contribuindo com análises, diagnósticos e dados para embasar decisões executivas;
  • Promover a cultura de dados na área, coordenando a estruturação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e análises preditivas voltadas à eficiência administrativa e tomada de decisão;
  • Acompanhar, dar visibilidade e reportar o andamento das entregas e metas da área, com base em indicadores estratégicos e operacionais;
  • Atuar como facilitador entre áreas administrativas, comerciais e demais diretorias, promovendo sinergia, eficiência e integração das informações;
  • Gerir e orientar as equipes Administrativa e de Contratos, assegurando o uso das melhores práticas de gestão e conformidade com normas internas;
  • Garantir a qualidade e pontualidade no atendimento às demandas das áreas de negócio, com foco em excelência operacional e entendimento das especificidades de cada área;
  • Mapear e propor melhorias contínuas em processos e serviços, com base em análises de dados, necessidades do negócio e benchmarks de mercado;
  • Coordenar a produção e validação de relatórios gerenciais e análises de desempenho, assegurando a integridade e relevância das informações;
  • Gerenciar os processos e atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, implementando boas práticas e assegurando a aderência às políticas de qualidade e gestão de riscos;
  • Estabelecer cronogramas, indicadores e metas de produtividade, acompanhando a execução e garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e objetivos;
  • Negociar e acompanhar o fornecimento e qualidade das informações enviadas pelas demais gerências, assegurando entregas analíticas completas e no prazo;
  • Estruturar, documentar e manter atualizados os processos sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e eficiência operacional;
  • Apoiar os gestores das áreas de negócio quanto às políticas corporativas e diretrizes administrativas, promovendo a padronização e conformidade;
  • Conduzir a agenda de governança da área, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento, execução e prestação de contas;
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas: acompanhar, desenvolver e avaliar o desempenho da equipe, promovendo clima organizacional positivo e foco em resultados;
  • Ser referência na vivência dos valores e cultura da empresa, atuando com protagonismo e espírito colaborativo;
  • Controlar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, com foco na eficiência dos recursos e alinhamento com o planejamento estratégico;

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado e Especializações correlacionada a área.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Fluxo, processo de vendas e ferramentas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento de processo administrativo de vendas e contratos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;

Habilidades Desejáveis:

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)

Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Ventilaçao)
description:
Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Foco: Ventilação)
 
Excelente oportunidade para uma pessoa qualificada e com experiência na área de planejamento de mina, foco em ventilação.
 
A empresa
Nosso cliente é uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do mundo em atuação no país.
 
 A posição
Em um ambiente de mineração subterrânea onde a ventilação é o pilar fundamental da segurança e produtividade, você terá o desafio de conduzir o planejamento estratégico de sistemas de ventilação e refrigeração de minas subterrâneas. Essa posição exige expertise técnica para assegurar que a disciplina esteja em acordo com normas regulatórias e padrões internos. Trata-se de uma oportunidade única de planejar sistemas de ventilação de alta complexidade em minerações profundas. Suas decisões contribuirão diretamente em assegurar um ambiente de trabalho confortável e seguro para os times operacionais.
 
Responsabilidades
 
 Como especialista no tema, você será responsável por dimensionar e operacionalizar sistemas de ventilação que sustentem as operações de frentes de trabalho em acordo com o planejamento anual e estratégico de produção. Suas atribuições também incluem colaboração no design da mina, participação em projetos e comitês de emergência, execução de tarefas técnicas, com foco em resultados práticos e conformidade:
  • Simulação e Modelagem: Empregar softwares como Deswik, Ventsim para simulações termodinâmicas do fluxo de ar na mina, incluindo cenários de produção, dimensionamento de frota, geotermia bem como cenários de emergência. Validar os modelos com dados reais para assegurar a calibração do modelo.
  • Integração com Planos de Produção e Lavra: Analisar impactos básicos da ventilação em planos de lavra, desenvolvimento, sondagem e infraestrutura, colaborando com as diferentes áreas e assegurar resposta a variações operacionais. Ser o guardião dos padrões internos, assegurando equilíbrio entre segurança e metas de produção.
  • Conformidade com Normas Regulamentadoras: Garantir adesão às normas principais, como NR-22, ABNT NBR 16401, padrões internos da companhia, realizando revisões regulares e melhorias nos padrões.
  • Gestão de Perdas e Recirculações: Identificar perdas de ar através de inspeções em campo com instrumentos de medição, propor estratégias para reduzir recirculações, perdas. Interagir com as diversas disciplinas para construção do sequenciamento de atividades para melhorar a eficiência.
  • Melhoria de qualidade das instalações de ventilação: Desenvolver soluções com foco em melhores materiais, métodos ou tecnologias que assegurem a conformidade das vedações das estruturas que compõe o sistema de ventilação.
 
 Requisitos
É essencial que o profissional possua as seguintes habilidades e qualificações:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia (Minas, Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil) com CREA ativo.
  • Especialização: Conhecimentos em aerodinâmica básica de minas, segurança subterrânea e princípios de sistemas de ar, com interesse em certificações em ventilação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com softwares de planejamento de minas (ex.: Deswik, Datamine) e ventilação (ex.: Ventsim). Elaboração de apresentações executivas. Análise estatística de dados. Compreensão de normas técnicas nacionais.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 4 anos em mineração subterrânea, com pelo menos 2 anos em atividades relacionadas a ventilação de minas subterrâneas. Experiência em projetos de média escala, incluindo monitoramento e ajustes operacionais.
 
Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times internacionais e compreensão de bibliografia técnica.
  • Pós-Graduação na área de Ventilação ou Engenharia de Minas;

A empresa proporcionará um pacote atrativo de remuneração e benefícios.

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.

Responsibilities:

Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development

Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders

Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities

Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Clinical Market Expert - Ultrasound
description:
Job Title: Clinical Market Expert - Ultrasound

Company: CHISON

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

About Us:

CHISON is a global medical device company dedicated to innovation in ultrasound imaging . With a presence in over 100 countries, we are committed to improving medical care through cutting-edge ultrasound technology . Our values of Innovation, High-Quality, Passion, and Integrity drive our mission to make everyone healthier. Our vision is to become the leader in specialized ultrasound .

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Clinical Market Expert specializing in Ultrasound to be the key clinical and technical authority for CHISON in the Brazilian market. You will be the pivotal link between our ultrasound technology and the clinical community, driving market growth by leveraging deep ultrasound application expertise to shape marketing strategy, enable the sales team, and build lasting relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). This role requires hands-on clinical experience with ultrasound systems.

Core Responsibilities:

  1. Provide ultrasound-specific clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, demonstrating the full range of CHISON ultrasound systems , their capabilities, benefits, and potential clinical applications to customers.
  2. Develop and deliver high-level product training and education on ultrasound equipment operation and clinical best practices to customers and distributors.
  3. Create and validate compelling clinical marketing content (e.g., case studies, application notes, whitepapers) that showcases the clinical advantages of CHISON ultrasound solutions in areas such as General Imaging, Vascular, and OB/GYN.
  4. Support the development and execution of the regional ultrasound product marketing strategy and plan, working closely with the sales manager to achieve key performance indicators.
  5. Lead Key Opinion Leader (KOL) development and management within the ultrasound community in Brazil.
  6. Organize and support marketing activities, including webinars, seminars, workshops, and major trade shows/conferences, by performing advanced ultrasound product demonstrations .
  7. Monitor customer installations and provide post-sale clinical support to ensure high customer satisfaction and foster long-term relationships.
  8. Collaborate closely with the global marketing and R&D teams to relay market feedback and identify new ultrasound business opportunities .

Skills & Qualifications:

Mandatory Requirements:

  1. Clinical Ultrasound Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience performing diagnostic ultrasound examinations in a clinical setting (e.g., hospital, imaging center). Proficiency in General Imaging/Abdominal and Vascular Sonography is required.
  2. Industry Background: Proven experience working directly with ultrasound devices . Previous roles in a clinical application specialist, sonographer, or similar capacity within an ultrasound equipment manufacturer are highly preferred.
  3. Language & Location: Full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English . Must be based in or willing to relocate to São Paulo State, Brazil .

Preferred Skills & Attributes:

  1. Marketing/Business Acumen: Prior experience in a commercial, marketing, or clinical support role within the medical device industry, specifically ultrasound .
  2. Technical & Soft Skills: Creative thinker, excellent presenter, problem-solver, and a self-motivated team player with strong interpersonal skills.
  3. Additional Clinical Knowledge: Experience in Cardiac or OB/GYN ultrasound is a significant advantage.

title: Avionics Engineer B2 (Riyadh Based)
description:
This role will be located at our Hub in Riyadh. A full and comprehensive relocation package will be offered.

About the Company

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role

Are you wired for success and passionate about advanced aircraft systems? Are you ready to take your career to a new altitude? We're seeking an experienced hands-on professional to join our Engineering and Maintenance team.

Your responsibility will be to perform maintenance, repairs, and inspections of our Boeing 787 fleet, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Additionally, typical duties include carrying out scheduled and unscheduled aircraft, engine, component maintenance and repairs compliant to the approved manufacturers documentation whilst observing all company safety procedures.

With a natural ability to lead in a time-critical environment, you will supervise teams undertaking Line Maintenance to optimise aircraft downtime. Key to this role is the inspection and certification of scheduled maintenance tasks, defect rectification, modifications, and functional tests on Airframe, Engine and Electrical systems.

Your days will be spent troubleshooting to keep our aircraft’s brains (avionics systems) in tip-top shape.

About You

A minimum Diploma/Certificate qualification and you will possess at least 8 years in Line Maintenance. Importantly, your maintenance experience includes the last 2 years certifying Boeing 787.

Boeing 787 Type Rating Level 3. You are also required to possess a valid GACA / EASA or other CAA B2 AV Aircraft Maintenance License.

The following mandatory documents are required and must be uploaded as part of your application:

  • Valid GACA / EASA or other CAA valid B2 AV Aircraft Maintenance License
  • Boeing 787 Aircraft Type training Level III original (practical and theoretical)
  • Last five (5) years aircraft maintenance experience records (logbook) stamped and signed by MRO/Operator Quality Assurance department.
  • Recency Letter from current (and previous employers if applicable) outlining scope of work and work duration, stamped and signed by Maintenance Repair Organisations (MRO) Quality Assurance Department
  • Current and previous Operator / MRO Certification Authorisation copy

You are also required to hold the appropriate police security clearance required for the role.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: Full Stack Engineer PHP/Javascript
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

Role Type: Full-Time Regular Employment

Setup: Fully Remote

Duration: Open-ended, Long term

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: US Eastern Time (EST)

Rate: USD 3,500-4,000 per month

Position Overview:

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client’s core business applications. We are looking for a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong foundational skills in vanilla JavaScript , pure PHP , and writing code from scratch without the support of abstractions or libraries.

You will work across both the front-end and back-end of modern web applications using PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React , collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and maintainable systems. Strong English communication skills are essential for interacting with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams.

What You Will Do:

The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code without depending heavily on frameworks, ensuring clarity and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and long-term stability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to decisions involving raw code structure, system design, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure the product is performant, reliable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Stay updated with evolving best practices in no-framework development , JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and full stack engineering.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, especially in understanding code fundamentals and building solutions without relying on frameworks.
  • Prepare and maintain clear and detailed technical documentation.

What You Will Bring:

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested pure code in both PHP and JavaScript (examples may be requested).
  • Strong knowledge of vanilla JavaScript , DOM manipulation, event handling, and building functionality without libraries.
  • Expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL , with hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or modern front-end frameworks, while still having the ability to work without them when needed.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in agile, team-based environments.
  • Knowledge of the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a passion for writing beautiful code.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, globally distributed environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with pure PHP , vanilla JavaScript , MySQL , PostgreSQL , SQL , and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build solutions from scratch without relying on frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex projects from concept to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC principles and agile methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.

title: Lawson Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Lawson Developer with extensive experience in the AS400 (IBM i) environment. In this role, you will be the backbone of our retail operations, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining critical Lawson ERP modules especially Retail accounting/finance. You will bridge the gap between legacy stability and modern retail demands, ensuring our inventory, financial, and supply chain systems run without a hitch.

  • Application Development: Design and code enhancements for Lawson S3 or M3 modules using RPG (III, IV, ILE, Free Format) and CL on the IBM i platform.
  • System Integration: Develop and manage interfaces (API, EDI, FTP) between Lawson and third-party retail systems, such as Point of Sale (POS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and E-commerce platforms.
  • Database Management: Maintain and optimize DB2/400 databases, ensuring data integrity across high-volume retail transactions.
  • Troubleshooting: Act as the Tier 3 support for Lawson-related issues, performing root-cause analysis on batch jobs, job streams, and system bottlenecks.
  • Modernization: Assist in migrating or modernizing legacy green-screen processes into web-based or GUI environments using Infor modern tools (e.g., Infor OS, Ming.le).
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain detailed technical specifications, system maps, and disaster recovery procedures.

Required Technical Skills

  • Core Languages: Mastery of RPGLE (ILE), SQLRPGLE, CL, and DB2 SQL.
  • Lawson Expertise: Strong functional and technical knowledge of Lawson/Infor financial suites (specifically Procurement, Inventory, Accounts Payable, and General Ledger ).
  • OS/400 Proficiency: Deep understanding of IBM i operating systems, Work Management, and Job Scheduling (e.g., ROBOT/SCHEDULE).
  • Integration Tools: Experience with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and XML/JSON for retail data exchange.
  • Reporting: Proficiency with Lawson Business Intelligence (LBI) or Crystal Reports.

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua

Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.

Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.

The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.

Learn more at our website,  

The Opportunity

We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.

We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.

What You'll Do

Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.

Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.

Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.

Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.

What You'll Get

Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs

Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition

Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support

100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties

Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region

What We're Looking For

Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:

Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.

Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.

Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.

Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.

Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.

Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.

The Deal

We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.

If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.

If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. ● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência

Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)

Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers

Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)

Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io

Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua

DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Talent Acquisition Specialist para liderar e executar o recrutamento ponta a ponta na Klavi, garantindo a atração e contratação de talentos de alta performance, alinhados à nossa cultura, valores e ritmo de crescimento.

Cultura Klavi

Busca incansável pela excelência:

Somos automotivados, inconformados com o status quo e sempre buscamos evoluir. Cada pessoa deve ser referência em sua área e no negócio como um todo. Elevamos constantemente o padrão de qualidade dos nossos produtos, serviços e processos.

Inovar para revolucionar:

Incentivamos a curiosidade e o questionamento. Estamos abertos a novas ideias e não temos medo de mudanças.

Construção coletiva e reconhecimento compartilhado:

Colaboramos, celebramos conquistas juntos e agimos com transparência, respeito e confiança. Não reclamamos — resolvemos problemas em conjunto.

Foco no sucesso do cliente:

Nosso sucesso depende do sucesso dos nossos clientes. Buscamos sempre superar expectativas e gerar valor de longo prazo.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ser responsável pelo recrutamento end-to-end de posições técnicas e não técnicas, desde o alinhamento de perfil até a oferta e transição para onboarding.
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) do time de People e das lideranças, ajudando a definir prioridades, perfis, senioridade e expectativas de mercado.
  • Desenhar e executar estratégias de sourcing ativo para atrair talentos qualificados, utilizando múltiplos canais (LinkedIn, outbound search, networking, comunidades e referrals).
  • Conduzir entrevistas estruturadas e avaliações comportamentais e técnicas, garantindo decisões consistentes e justas.
  • Atuar como advisor de hiring managers, trazendo visão de mercado, benchmarks salariais e recomendações de contratação.
  • Garantir uma excelente experiência para candidatos(as) em todas as etapas do processo seletivo.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.

  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.

title: Regional Sales Executive[Portuguese]
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Job Description

We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management: Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding: Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy: Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting: Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support: Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination: Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Técnico (a) de Controle de Qualidade JR
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. title: Analista de Microbiologia
description:
Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

A posição de Analista de Microbiologia é um componente importante de nosso time de Autógenas localizado em Guarulhos - SP.

Detalhes de posição

Dirigir, coordenar, organizar e priorizar as atividades da microbiologia (bacteriologia, virologia, biologia molecular e produção das sementes bacterianas e virais. Desenvolver protocolos e procedimentos referentes as demandas da rotina e de pesquisa de novos microorganismos , quando aplicavel. Ter conhecimento das técnicas de isolamento e identificação bacteriana e viral, avaliação de morfologia bacteriana, titulação viral, avaliação de efeito citopático, provas bioquímicas, produção de meios de cultura, conhecimento das principais patologias animais. Realizar os testes isolamento viral e bacteriano, bem como testes ligados a caracterização final dos microorganismos, visando a adequada seleção das sementes bacterianas e virais a serem utilizadas na produção de vacinas autógenas.

Responsabilidades chave

  • Realizar e acompanhar via supervisão direta as atividades do laboratório de microbiologia, desde o recebimento das amostras , sejam para diagnóstico , identificação ou seleção de sementes para produção de vacinas ,
  • Manter controle do estoque mínimo de insumos para realização das atividades.
  • Realizar os controles internos e externos de qualidade.
  • Auxiliar na análise dos resultados dos programas internos e externos de Controle da Qualidade.
  • Garantir que os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com os protocolos aprovados no laboratório.
  • Garantir que os registros de todas as etapas de diagnóstico sejam mantidos.
  • Liberar resultados pertinentes ao setor nos prazos acordados.
  • Acompanhar desvios de produção (problemas com amostras, resultados inconclusivos, resultados fora do prazo, resultados inconsistentes).
  • Elaborar, revisar e suportar a implementação de procedimentos, manuais da qualidade, e métodos analíticos necessários ao laboratório.
  • Manter comunicação clara e regular com o setor de diagnóstico, afim de cumprir as exigências e prazos na entrega dos resultados.
  • Promover reuniões regulares , para alinhamento de processos e treinamento de colaboradores.
  • Propor melhorias nos processos produtivos, implantação de novas tecnologias.
  • Acompanhar as demandas do laboratório de diagnostico, originadas dos problemas de campo a fim de auxiliar na identificação dos patógenos e sua caracterização.
  • Acompanhar os processos de validação de métodos analíticos, qualificação de equipamentos e calibração dos instrumentos do laboratório, referentes ao seu setor.
  • Garantir que os colaboradores do setor executem as operações de acordo com as normas de biossegurança vigentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade das sementes selecionadas para produção das vacinas bacterianas e virais.
  • Propor e executar planos de ação preventiva e corretiva decorrentes de investigações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhar auditorias dos órgãos governamentais e fiscalizadores e outras no setor, quando aplicável.
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua referentes a seu setor.
  • Realizar os programas de treinamento para garantir o treinamento periódico de forma a manter atualizado o cronograma.
  • Realizar isolamentos virais e testes complementares como titulação viral e moleculares para caracterização completa do vírus.
  • Manter o cultivo celular em dia , bem como todas atividades relacionadas aos processos.
  • Preparar meios para cultivo viral e bacteriano e de amostras para inoculação viral e bacteriana.
  • Manutenção do banco de sementes virais , celulares e bacterianas.
  • Realizar o controle de qualidade das sementes virais e bacterianas.
  • Auxiliar no controle de calibração e de certificação dos equipamentos da área.
  • Manter e repor materiais específicos a área de atuação,
  • Participar dos processos de reclamação de clientes, auxiliando na investigação das causas e na eficácia das ações implementadas.
  • Gerar indicadores e relatórios pertinentes a sua área.

Formação & Especializações:

Formação Superior nos cursos de Veterinária, Biologia, Farmácia ou Biomedicina.

Localidade: Guarulhos | São Paulo

Horário: segunda a sexta-feira das 07h45 às 16h45 ou terça-feira a sábado das 07h45 às 16h45

Todos os candidatos qualificados para a posição serão considerados independentemente de raça, nacionalidade, sexo, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, condição de veterano, estado civil ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

title: Head of AML (MLRO)
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

Job Description

An experienced and highly motivated Head of AML (MLRO) to lead our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) efforts in Brazil.

You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing our AML programme, ensuring adherence to local regulations.

Please apply with an English version of your CV.

Qualifications

  • Relevant qualifications, including Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS) certification.
  • Proven experience in AML compliance within the online gambling or financial services industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian AML regulations and international standards.

Additional Information

  • Developing and implementing a comprehensive AML strategy in line with Brazilian regulations and international best practices.
  • Acting as the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and serving as the primary point of contact for all AML related matters.
  • Monitoring and assessing the effectiveness of the AML programme, making necessary adjustments to policies and procedures as required.
  • Conducting risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential AML risks associated with our operations.
  • Overseeing the customer due diligence (CDD) process, ensuring compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements.
  • Providing training and guidance to staff on AML policies, procedures, and regulatory obligations.
  • Liaising with regulatory authorities, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders on AML matters.
  • Preparing and submitting required reports to regulatory bodies, including suspicious activity reports (SARs).
  • Keeping up to date with emerging trends and changes in AML regulations, ensuring the company remains compliant.
  • Collaborating with other departments to promote a culture of compliance and integrity within the organisation.

title: Coordenador de eventos
description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos

Sobre a Welcome:

Somos uma empresa de assessoria em viagens com o propósito de criar experiências e transformar pessoas. Nossa atuação é dividida em três frentes especializadas: Welcome Weddings , setor especializado em Destination Wedding, com assessoria completa e personalizada desde a da produção do casamento até a viagem. A Welcome Trips que é o setor especializado em viagens de lazer, onde a personalização e a excelência são a essência de cada roteiro, e Welcome Corp, focada em viagens corporativas e de incentivo.

A Welcome Weddings é reconhecida internacionalmente como a melhor produtora de Destination Wedding da América Latina. Mais do que realizar casamentos, nossa missão é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Os setores de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos são responsáveis por conceber, organizar e coordenar todos os detalhes de um Destination Wedding, desde a escolha do destino e do local ideais até a execução impecável de cada evento. A equipe compreende profundamente o perfil e os desejos do casal, orienta nas decisões mais adequadas, realiza a reserva da data, o bloqueio de apartamentos no hotel definido e estrutura toda a programação dos eventos. Além disso, conecta o casal aos profissionais ideais e garante que cada elemento reflita sua visão, proporcionando uma experiência única, personalizada e memorável.

Sua missão:

Sua missão será liderar, integrar e garantir a excelência de todo o processo do Destination Wedding , atuando da concepção à entrega final para garantir o propósito da Welcome Weddings que é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a operação completa dos eventos;
  • Liderar e orientar as equipes;
  • Supervisionar a escolha dos destinos e locais;
  • Acompanhar e validar reservas e bloqueios;
  • Garantir a estruturação da programação dos eventos;
  • Assegurar a personalização e a qualidade da entrega;
  • Monitorar a experiência do casal do início ao fim.

Suas principais atividades:

Acompanhar a jornada de cada casal com base nos processos de Planejamento e Produção, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade e personalização em todas as etapas. Estruturar, aprimorar e monitorar continuamente os processos de Planejamento e Produção junto à Wedding Planner responsável por cada projeto. Apoiar as demandas operacionais dos departamentos, definindo a Wedding Planner responsável por cada casal em cada fase do processo. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas semanais com os departamentos, promovendo alinhamento e tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e capacitar os times, apoiando o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) de cada colaborador. Atuar como elo entre coordenadores e diretoria, assegurando comunicação clara e estratégica. Prevenir e gerenciar situações de crise, garantindo soluções rápidas, eficazes e alinhadas aos valores da empresa. Acompanhar metas e indicadores de desempenho de cada setor, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções. Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos e representar a Welcome em eventos institucionais e do mercado de eventos.

title: Supervisor de Vendas - São Bernardo Plaza

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

Informações adicionais:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We’re Hiring | HR Coordinator (Brazil)

We are looking for a proactive and organized HR Coordinator with 4-6 years of experience to join our team in Brazil. This role will support core Human Resources activities while ensuring alignment with local labor legislation and Company Global HR standards.

The HR Coordinator will support day-to-day HR operations, acting as a key partner for employees and leadership. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively in both Portuguese and English/ Spanish .

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Administration, Psychology, or related field
  • 4-6 years of experience in Human Resources (generalist or coordinator role)
  • Good English level (written and spoken) – mandatory
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian labor laws
  • Experience supporting payroll, benefits, and employee administration
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • High level of confidentiality and ethical behavior
  • Proficiency in MS Office and HR systems

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support employee lifecycle management: hiring, contracts, amendments, and offboarding
  • Assist with payroll inputs, benefits administration, time and attendance control
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and Brazilian labor legislation
  • Maintain accurate and updated employee records and HR reports
  • Support internal HR programs such as training, performance management, and engagement initiatives
  • Serve as a point of contact for employee questions related to HR policies and processes

Interested?

If you are passionate about Human Resources and looking to grow your career in a multicultural and dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you.

É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Experiência com inside sales , atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais.

description:

HR operations & lifecycle management

description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Unix Linux System Administrator
description:

  • Hands-on experience in Linux and Unix systems

title: Gerente de loja
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!

Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com Rede Wi-fi mais estável do Brasil. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).

No Brasil, estamos presentes em mais de 4.600, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Liderando no saldo de portabilidade em 2022, com 1,2 milhões de linhas portadas, há mais de 5 anos.

E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez mais e melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais!

Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel)e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros.

Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e startups, que é o nosso hub de inovação, beOn Claro, e desenvolvemos projetos focados na sustentabilidade, como o programa de Energia Limpa, que já contempla mais de 60% das antenas da Claro com energia renovável.

É claro que, para fazer tudo isso acontecer, a gente tem um grande time!

Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e que unem as nossas Pessoas ao propósito único que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Garantir o alcance das metas de vendas estipuladas.
  • Garantir a qualidade e efetividade de atendimento, alcançando as metas dos indicadores de qualidade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o resultado operacional da loja. Garantir a performance e controles das rotinas diárias e administrativas.
  • Garantir a equalização do conhecimento e qualidade da equipe.
  • Garantir que os fluxos de venda e atendimento estejam dentro do padrão.
  • Zelar pela aparência e conservação do ponto de venda.
  • Zelar pela aparência e comportamento da equipe de acordo com o Jeito Claro.
  • Realizar treinamentos dentro do prazo e com qualidade.
  • Controlar giro de estoque.
  • Buscar oportunidades de vendas.
  • Desenvolver a equipe através de acompanhamento e feedback.
  • Fazer a gestão da loja e garantir que ela opere dentro dos padrões definidos pelo Canal Direto.
  • Focar na microgestão, realizando uma gestão contínua junto aos vendedores com o objetivo de formar e desenvolver uma equipe motivada e adequada para o atingimento dos resultados.
  • Gerenciar o resultado operacional da loja garantindo a rentabilidade.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

  • Sólida vivência na gestão de lojas, varejo, ou afins, preferencialmente no segmento de telecomunicações, tecnologia ou serviços.
  • Vivência com Gestão de Pessoas

E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:
